text: Multidisciplinary tumor board discussion for 68M with stage IIIA lung adenocarcinoma, EGFR exon 19 deletion positive. ATTENDEES: Medical oncology, radiation oncology, thoracic surgery, pulmonology, radiology, pathology. PRESENTATION: Patient with newly diagnosed stage IIIA (T2aN2M0) lung adenocarcinoma, EGFR mutation positive, good performance status (ECOG 1). DISCUSSION: Given stage IIIA disease with N2 involvement, not optimal surgical candidate upfront. EGFR mutation makes patient eligible for targeted therapy. PLAN: Recommend neoadjuvant targeted therapy with EGFR TKI (osimertinib) for 3-6 months, followed by reassessment for surgical resection. If surgery not feasible, continue systemic therapy with consideration of consolidation radiation. Patient counseled and agrees with treatment plan.
